settings.scope: deterministic cube contact/lift diagnostic with fixed arm gains and two finger candidates; no policy inference or native scene equivalence claim
settings.initial_reference: static native FK at recorded arm joints; original dynamic pose retained separately
settings.initial_velocity_note: Isaac starts held near zero velocity; original native segment was moving; this is an execution diagnostic, not matched dynamic state replay

initial_velocity_comparison.scope: original recorded native dynamic state versus held Isaac start; for pose variants original velocities belong to the original pose, not a matched initial dynamic reference

semantics_replay_input.scope: same actual first up-to-100 Isaac controls; zero new inference, no padding or additional settling

policy_semantics.scope: model pose and declared gripper policy throughout; no geometric close gate, refinement or program lift; cube proxy, not LIBERO benchmark
policy_semantics.timing_scope: 50ms controls; physics paused during inference; gripper ramp remains 0.1m/s, not native dynamics equivalence

lift_check.scope: 40 successive model-driven controls; kinematic lift/relative-pose evidence, no contact-force measurement

physics_checks.finger_force_scope: computed/applied drive buffers, not object contact forces
